36: Cycle to your flagship's next secondary weapon. After cycling through all secondary weapons individually, selects every secondary weapon at once, then selects no weapons.
37: Fire your flagship's selected secondary weapon(s).
38: Activate or deactivate your fleet's cloaking devices, if any are installed.
39: Turrets aim towards your cursor when this key is held. If the "Aim turrets with mouse" setting is enabled, it will do the opposite.
40: Cause your flagship to turn toward your mouse if this key is held. To have mouse turning always active, activate the "Control ship with mouse" setting. If that setting is active, holding this key deactivates mouse turning.
42: Toggle whether the game is in fullscreen mode.
43: Toggle a 3x speed fast-forward. Fast-forward may be automatically deactivated by the "Interrupt fast-forward" setting. If the key is set to caps-lock then the caps-lock state will be used to determine the fast-forward state.
44: Stop time in the game. You can still select ships, give commands, and interact with menus.
45: Display the help dialogs that are relevant to your current UI panel and situation. Uses the same help dialogs from the "Reactivate first-time help" setting, forcing them to appear even if they have already appeared before.
46: Open the log panel containing status messages and hails from other ships received since the current pilot was loaded.
47: Toggle the "Show CPU / GPU load" setting.
48: Deploy or recall carried ships (e.g. fighters, drones) in your fleet. Requires carriers with space to hold the carried ships.
49: Carried ships may automatically return to the carrier when damaged and redeploy when healed based off of the "Damaged fighters retreat" setting.
50: When used while holding <shift> or with the aforementioned setting disabled, fighters will remain deployed until manually recalled.
51: Command your entire fleet to focus fire on the selected target. If only some escorts are selected, only sends the command to those escorts. This command can also be sent by right clicking on a hostile ship.
52: Command your fleet to stop firing except if they are given a specific target to shoot at afterwards. If only some escorts are selected, only sends the command to those escorts.
53: Command your fleet to gather around your flagship. If only some escorts are selected, only sends the command to those escorts. You can also command escorts to gather around another ship by right clicking on a friendly ship.
54: With <shift>, change the formation pattern in your fleet.
55: Command your fleet to hold its current position. If only some escorts are selected, only sends the command to those escorts. This command can also be sent by right clicking on empty space.
57: Command your fleet to harvest nearby flotsam (e.g. dropped cargo). The "Flotsam collection" setting must allow your escorts to pick up flotsam in order to harvest it.
58: Command your fleet to scan a target. Requires your escorts to have cargo or outfit scanners installed. If only some escorts are selected, only sends the command to those escorts.
59: Increase the main zoom factor (the size of the UI and gameplay). Wraps back to 100 if the zoom exceeds your screen's limits.
60: Increase the zoom factor of the gameplay view when in flight. Can also be changed by the + and - keys and the scroll wheel.
61: Sets the horizontal text alignment of paragraphs across the UI.
65: - "justified": add extra space between words to align with both margins.
66: Sets the font size to be used by text in various parts of the UI. Note that this only impacts text that is displayed in areas that can expand or scroll to fit a larger font size. If you want to increase the size of all text, you should increase the main zoom factor.
67: Toggle whether the game is in windowed or fullscreen mode. Can also be toggled by the "Toggle fullscreen" control.
68: Toggle vsync between off, on, and adaptive (should your computer support it).
69: Determines where the screen center is positioned relative to the flagship while accelerating.
